name: Cthulhu Wars (4 players, 5-3 map)
description: Three to five rival cults fight to wake their Great Old Ones and open the most gates: spend Power on recruiting, moving, summoning and battling over a simplified world map, earn spellbooks, and be first past 30 Doom with all six books. Six cults to choose from — Great Cthulhu, Crawling Chaos, Black Goat, Yellow Sign, Windwalker and Sleeper — and the High Priests as an optional expansion.
rules: Cthulhu Wars is a game of three to five cults — Great Cthulhu, Crawling Chaos, Black Goat, Yellow Sign and, from the first expansion, Windwalker and Sleeper — racing to open Gates, awaken their Great Old Ones and gain Doom. Each round: everyone spends Power on actions, gathers new Power from cultists and Gates, and then scores Doom for the Gates they control (and may perform a Ritual of Annihilation).

The first player to reach 30 Doom ends the game at the end of that Doom phase; the player with the most Doom and all six spellbooks wins. If nobody has all six spellbooks, humanity wins and every cult loses.

Open the Guide tabs in this window for the full rules: the round, every action, battles, the factions and their spellbooks, the High Priests, the neutral cards (neutral spellbooks, Monsters and Terrors with Loyalty Cards), the Independent Great Old Ones and the map.

ocean.label: Ocean
ocean.text: Ocean areas: Great Cthulhu's Submerge, Y'ha-Nthlei and gate requirements refer to them.

desecrated.label: Desecrated
desecrated.text: A Desecration token lies here (Yellow Sign).

gate-0.label: Abandoned Gate
gate-0.text: A Gate nobody controls: it still gives 1 Power to every player in Gather Power. A unit that arrives takes it, and so does a unit of yours already there — select it, then click the Gate.

gate-1.label: Gate (Great Cthulhu)
gate-1.text: A Gate controlled by Great Cthulhu. The figure on it is the unit that occupies it, apart from the others of its kind there: click yours to move it — that abandons the Gate.

gate-2.label: Gate (Crawling Chaos)
gate-2.text: A Gate controlled by Crawling Chaos. The figure on it is the unit that occupies it, apart from the others of its kind there: click yours to move it — that abandons the Gate.

gate-3.label: Gate (Black Goat)
gate-3.text: A Gate controlled by Black Goat. The figure on it is the unit that occupies it, apart from the others of its kind there: click yours to move it — that abandons the Gate.

gate-4.label: Gate (Yellow Sign)
gate-4.text: A Gate controlled by Yellow Sign. The figure on it is the unit that occupies it, apart from the others of its kind there: click yours to move it — that abandons the Gate.

target.label: Battle
target.text: The area where a battle is being fought.

gate-5.label: Gate (Windwalker)
gate-5.text: A Gate controlled by Windwalker. The figure on it is the unit that occupies it, apart from the others of its kind there: click yours to move it — that abandons the Gate.

iceage.label: Ice Age
iceage.text: Windwalker's Ice Age token: enemy Actions that end here cost 1 Power more.

options.label: Factions
options.text: Which cult sits in each seat. The seats are the players of the table; no cult can be chosen twice.

choices.label: Great Cthulhu
choices.text: Deep Ones, Shoggoths, Star Spawn and Cthulhu.

choices.label: Crawling Chaos
choices.text: Nightgaunts, Flying Polyps, Hunting Horrors and Nyarlathotep: everything flies.

choices.label: Black Goat
choices.text: Ghouls, Fungi, Dark Young and Shub-Niggurath.

choices.label: Yellow Sign
choices.text: Undead, Byakhee, the King in Yellow and Hastur.

choices.label: Windwalker
choices.text: Expansion: Wendigos, Gnoph-Keh, Rhan-Tegoth and Ithaqua. Needs the polar areas.

choices.label: Sleeper
choices.text: Expansion: Wizards, Serpent Men, Formless Spawn and Tsathoggua.

choices.label: Opener of the Way
choices.text: Expansion: Mutants, Abominations, Spawn of Yog-Sothoth and Yog-Sothoth, who is a Gate himself; moves Gates.

choices.label: Tcho-Tcho
choices.text: Expansion: High Priests, Proto-Shoggoths and Ubbo-Sathla, whose Growth counter feeds on the Doom phases.

options.label: High Priests
options.text: The expansion: every cult has one High Priest, a Cultist that is recruited for 3 Power, gives 1 Power, can hold a Gate — and can be sacrificed for 2 Power (Unspeakable Oath).

options.label: Azathoth (neutral spellbooks and Monsters)
options.text: The neutral content of the Azathoth faction. Any cult may take one of the six neutral spellbooks (Shriveling, Stars Are Right, Recriminations, The Mao Ceremony, Umr at-Tawil, Undimensioned) in place of one of its own, and may buy the Loyalty Card of a neutral Monster (Dimensional Shambler, Star Vampire, Elder Thing, Servitor of the Outer Gods) for 2 Doom in the Doom phase.

options.label: Dreamlands Surface Monsters
options.text: Three neutral Monsters whose Loyalty Cards are bought with 2 Doom in the Doom phase: the Moonbeast (lies on an enemy spellbook), the Gnorri (extra Doom for two or three in play) and the Shantak (moves anywhere and carries a Cultist).

options.label: Beyond Time and Space
options.text: Two neutral Monsters, the Wamp (an enemy places them where there is no Gate) and the Voonith (makes up Kills), and a Terror, the Hound of Tindalos, whose card costs 2 Doom and 2 Power.

options.label: Independent: Abhoth (Great Old One Pack 1)
options.text: An Independent Great Old One any cult may awaken (a Gate it controls in an area with one of its Great Old Ones). Filth Tokens as meat shields and a spellbook that spoils the others' Gates. For a first game use one Independent fewer than there are players.

options.label: Independent: Chaugnar Faugn (Great Old One Pack 1)
options.text: An Independent Great Old One any cult may awaken (a Gate it controls in an area with one of its Great Old Ones). +3 dice in battles at your Gates, and a spellbook that lets you choose the Elder Signs others receive. For a first game use one Independent fewer than there are players.

options.label: Independent: Cthugha (Great Old One Pack 1)
options.text: An Independent Great Old One any cult may awaken (a Gate it controls in an area with one of its Great Old Ones). Replaces one of your Great Old Ones; spares the Units he Kills for Power. For a first game use one Independent fewer than there are players.

options.label: Independent: Mother Hydra (Great Old One Pack 1)
options.text: An Independent Great Old One any cult may awaken (a Gate it controls in an area with one of its Great Old Ones). Drives Cultists out of an ocean, and a spellbook that places all your Acolytes at once. For a first game use one Independent fewer than there are players.

options.label: Independent: Yig (Great Old One Pack 1)
options.text: An Independent Great Old One any cult may awaken (a Gate it controls in an area with one of its Great Old Ones). Poisons your Cultists, and a spellbook that makes the others pay you Power or Doom. For a first game use one Independent fewer than there are players.

options.label: Neutral spellbook instead of a timer book
options.text: Ghroth (Black Goat) and The Thousand Forms (Crawling Chaos) need a clock, which is awkward when the turns are days apart. Replace the book with one of the six neutral spellbooks — even without the Azathoth option; each neutral spellbook can replace one book only.

slots.label: Ghroth
slots.text: Black Goat: the action that gives its enemies a minute to decide who loses Cultists.

slots.label: The Thousand Forms
slots.text: Crawling Chaos: the negotiation over how much Power the others pay.

choices.label: Shriveling
choices.text: Pre-Battle: eliminate an enemy Monster or Cultist in the battle; its owner gets Power equal to its cost.

choices.label: Stars Are Right
choices.text: Ongoing: revealing Elder Signs in the Doom phase also gives Power equal to their value.

choices.label: Recriminations
choices.text: Action (1 Power): set aside any spellbook of yours and take another available one.

choices.label: The Mao Ceremony
choices.text: Ongoing: after Gather Power sacrifice any number of your Cultists for 1 Power each.

choices.label: Undimensioned
choices.text: Action (2 Power): rearrange your units among the areas where you already have some.
